purpose: Release audit of the Parchmatte macOS screen-texture overlay: behaviour, performance and security checks per docs/TEST_PLAN.md and docs/SECURITY_PLAN.md.

suites.windows: Window covers: align, follow, minimize, hide, look-alike, close, quit, second display (C0-C5, C9, A2)
suites.fullscreen: Native full screen for window and whole-screen covers (B2)
suites.spaces: Desktop swipes for window and whole-screen covers (B1, B7)
suites.drag: Tracking lag while a covered window moves (C1)
suites.perf: CPU and idle wake-ups: whole screen, 1 and 5 window covers, moving (H1-H3)
suites.netwatch: No network sockets while exercising every hotkey (S4)
suites.softness: Softness pipeline: level 0 equals source, even steps
suites.layouts: Hotkey key resolution under US, German, French, Dvorak (G8)
suites.fuzz: Hostile preference values: 13 keys x 11 values, launch survival (S5)

pass_criteria: Every suite exits 0; checks_failed = 0; sockets_seen = 0; launches_crashed = 0; uncovered = 0 for drag and spaces.
